title: Session log
description: Post-session summary. Lives alongside the session's events.jsonl and snapshot.json under sessions/<date>/.

name.description: Usually the session date in YYYY-MM-DD form, optionally suffixed with a short title.

date.description: Real-world date the session was played.

inGameDate.description: In-game date at the end of the session.

episode.description: Reference to the episode that was played, by id or name.

scenes.description: Scenes touched during this session, in order.

presentPcs.description: Which PCs were present (their players were at the table or online).

summary.description: Narrative summary for sharing with players. Markdown. Players review and remember; this also seeds the next session's prep.

drift.description: DM-private alignment-drift notes (per-PC). May be moved to dm/ if it includes spoilers.

marks.description: Milestone marks earned this session, per PC.

dmReflections.description: DM's private notes on how the session went. Often lives in dm/ subfolders rather than the public log.
